test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A boat takes 2 hours to cover a certain distance downstream, but it takes 3(1)/(4) hours to cover the same distance upstream. If the speed of the stream is 5 km/h, then what is the speed (in km/h) of the boat in still water?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken in downstream = 2 hours

Time taken in upstream = 13/4 hours

Speed of stream = 5 km/h

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

Let the distance covered be D

Let the speed of motorboat and stream be v and u respectively

According to the question,

⇒ 2 = D/(v + 5) ---------(1)

⇒ 13/4 = D/(v - 5) ----------(2)

By solving equation (2) we get,

⇒ 4D = 13v - 65 -------------(3)

Putting value of equation (1) in equation (3)

⇒ 4(2v + 10) = 13v - 65

⇒ 8v + 40 = 13v - 65 

⇒ 5v = 105

⇒ v = 21

**∴ The speed of the boat in still water is 21 km/h.**
